dispute_ticket.description: I cancelled my 6pm booking about 20 minutes before pick-up, so it should be free. I was charged S$6.00. Please refund it.

app_events.details: Driver D-1933 matched to advance booking at 16:50:30.
Rider cancelled advance booking 12 min 30 s before scheduled time 18:00:00.

advance_free_cancellation_before_schedul.text: For an advance booking, a rider who cancels MORE than this many minutes before the scheduled time owes no fee. Exactly 15 min 00 s before is not free.

advance_fee_cancelled_15_to_5_min_before.text: Fee in SGD for a rider who cancels an advance booking 15 minutes or less, but 5 minutes or more, before the scheduled time.

advance_fee_cancelled_under_5_min_before.text: Fee in SGD for a rider who cancels an advance booking less than 5 minutes before the scheduled time.

free_cancellation_within_min_of_match.text: Minutes after the driver is matched during which the rider may cancel without a fee. It governs rider cancellations only. The limit counts: a cancellation at exactly 3 min 00 s is still free.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: The booking was for 18:00:00 and the rider cancelled at 17:47:30, which is 12 min 30 s before. That is under the 15-min free limit (so not free, and the rider's 'about 20 minutes' is wrong) and the free 3-min window after matching had long passed (matched 16:50:30). It falls in this trip's 15-to-5-min tier, a S$3.00 fee, not the S$6.00 under-5-min tier that was charged. Refund = 6.00 - 3.00 = S$3.00.
